events.name: The Pastry Uprising
events.desc: The Great Dessert rises. Literally. Someone left the proofing spell on overnight.

events.name: The Moon Rent Strike
events.desc: Before the revolution, there was the rent strike. Stand with the rabbits.

events.name: Midnight Mall Madness
events.desc: One night a year, the Enchanted Mall holds a sale. Everything must go. Including shoppers.

events.name: Free Trial at the Astral Gym
events.desc: Seven days free. Cancel anytime. ("Anytime" not available in your dimension.)

stages.name: Day Three: The Void Stretches YOU

events.name: The Grand Snail Derby
events.desc: The meadow's deceptively fast snails hold their annual race. Betting is legal. Survival is optional.

events.name: Permit Amnesty Weekend
events.desc: The Darkwood forgives all expired permits. The catch: you must fight your way to the forgiveness desk.

events.name: Mount Grumble Ore Runs
events.desc: The dwarves (now fairly paid) open the mines on weekends. Ore for everyone who survives the goats.

events.name: The Library After Hours
events.desc: Goth Librarian Morticia leaves the skill-tome wing unlocked nightly. This is either kindness or a trap.

events.name: The Radiant Core: Deep Custody
events.desc: The custodians' inner sanctum. More cores, more concern, more mop-based violence.

events.name: The Tower of Tabs
events.desc: Ten sheets. Each tab worse than the last. The final tab has been hidden since creation.

events.name: The Tower of Eternal Hold
events.desc: Ten floors of Customer Service Hell's finest. The elevator music is a boss mechanic.

events.name: Boss Rush: Sovereigns of Silliness
events.desc: The Hold Queen, the Dead Letter King, the Moonlord, and the Grand Gateau. Royalty, rapid-fire.

events.name: Boss Rush: The Cosmic Escalation
events.desc: The endgame bosses, back to back to back. For heroes whose quarterly numbers are IMMACULATE.
